description: How good and how risky one Hyperliquid trader is over 7, 30 or 90 days, rebuilt from its fills: overall win rate, profit factor, trade count, realized PnL and max drawdown; the same numbers per market; its liquidations; and its trades from open to close with direction, timing and peak size. Use it to vet a wallet before following it. For plain totals over any time range use get_user_summary; for positions open right now use get_user_state; for style labels such as market_maker use get_wallet_behavior. A 90d window on a very active wallet can take several seconds.
name: get_trader_profile

profit_factor.description: Gross profit divided by gross loss

win_rate.description: Share of closed trades that were profitable, 0 to 1

notice.description: Present when the API added a note: how a market name was read, that data starts later than asked because of the history window, or a next step such as a free key
